steps: Go to the official Con Edison heat-pump water heater page and confirm you have an active Con Edison electric account.
Verify your eligibility and request your coupon code (via email or SMS, per the program's verification flow).
Shop in-store at a participating Lowe's or Home Depot (or order through a contractor supplied by a participating distributor) — online purchases do not qualify.
Choose an ENERGY STAR heat-pump water heater with a tank under 120 gallons.
Present your coupon code at the register; the retailer scans it and the $1,500 discount comes off the price immediately (for purchases Sep 1–Nov 30, 2026).
Keep your receipt; no mail-in claim is needed because the rebate is instant at the register.
